nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROB PHENOBARBITAL IV P:ROOT F:BASE $INPUT ID TIME AMT BWT APGA DV MDV EVID $DATA ../PHENO $SUBR ADVAN1 TRANS2 $PK CL = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1)) V = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2)) S1 = V
$ERROR IPRE = F W = SQRT(THETA(3)**2*IPRE**2 + THETA(4)**2) Y = IPRE + W*EPS(1) IRES = DV-IPRE IWRE = IRES/W
$THETA (0, 1) ; CL 1.40664 FIX (0, .1) ; Prop.RE (sd) (0, 1) ; Add.RE (sd)
$OMEGA 0.1 0.1
$SIGMA 1 FIX $EST MAX=9999 PRINT= 5 METHOD=COND INTER MSFO=THIS.MSF NOTBT NOOBT NOSBT NOABORT
$TAB ID TIME DV MDV EVID IPRE IWRE CWRES file = sdtab NOPRINT ONEHEADER $TAB CL V ETA(1) ETA(2) FILE =patab NOPRINT ONEHEADER NOAPPEND $TAB ID BWT APGA FILE= cotab NOPRINT ONEHEADER NOAPPEND ;$TAB ID APGA ; FILE=catab NOPRINT ONEHEADER NOAPPEND
